account.title: Account
account.description: Who you are and how Dramatis behaves for you, in every project and on every device.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHelp: The name Dramatis greets you with; exports are signed with the author name chosen in each project.

password.title: Password
password.description: There is no password reset by email yet: if you forget it, your projects come back only from a backup. Keep one.
password.wrong: The current password is not correct.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Each day's words are counted in this time zone: a session after midnight belongs to the new day.
timezone.search: Search for a city or a zone

editor.title: Writing page
editor.description: How the text looks in the editor, in every project. The editor's “Aa” menu changes the same choices.
editor.sansHelp: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, drawn for readers with low vision.
editor.sample: The six-twelve train slowed on the bridge, and for a moment the river turned to gold. Elena closed the notebook on her knees: the scene was there, whole, and she did not want to lose it before she got home.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.label: Guidance in new projects
guidance.help: The path from premise to delivery, the explanations and the hints, on in every new project. Each project can hide them later.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: One file per project, with all the text, the world of the story and the images: it imports back as a new project.

delete.title: Delete the account
delete.description: Deletes the account forever, with every project, text and image. It cannot be undone.
delete.warning: You are about to delete the account. | You are about to delete the account and the only project in it, even if it is among the deleted ones. | You are about to delete the account and the {n} projects in it, including the deleted ones.
delete.backupFirst: First download a backup of what you want to keep.
delete.done: The account has been deleted, with all its projects.
